items.title: TimeTeller puts our internal clocks at the center of personalized medicine
items.summary: German startup TimeTeller has developed a saliva test kit to help anyone understand their circadian rhythm; it aims to reduce side effects from cancer treatments.
items.creator: Anna Heim

items.title: Ambrosia Energy will build a 10 GWh factory in Texas to make batteries for off-grid data centers
items.summary: Startup Ambrosia Energy will build a massive factory to crank out batteries to augment solar panels, creating a round-the-clock clean power plant.
items.creator: Tim De Chant
